description: This file contains the implementation of the AwsClient class, which is a default AWS SDK client for interacting with AWS services. It includes methods for configuration, middleware setup, endpoint resolution, and request handling.

classes.name: Aws\AwsClient
classes.description: This class provides the main implementation for AWS service clients, offering configuration, middleware management, endpoint handling, and request creation functionalities.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the default arguments for constructing an AWS client.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AwsClient instance with specified configuration arguments.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list managing the middleware chain.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the client configuration or a specific option if provided.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns the credentials used by the client.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint URI for the service.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region string configured for the client.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the service API model associated with the client.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates and returns a command object for a specified operation.

methods.name: getEndpointProvider
methods.description: Returns the endpoint provider used for dynamic endpoint resolution.

methods.name: getClientContextParams
methods.description: Returns the client context parameters for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: getClientBuiltIns
methods.description: Returns built-in parameters used in endpoint resolution.

methods.name: emitDeprecationWarning
methods.description: Emits a warning if the PHP version is deprecated.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Applies document filters to the service API for documentation purposes.
